subject: Opal Platform renewal: governance checklist, capacity uplift & QBR timing
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@opalplatform.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Jacobs <ben.j@opalplatform.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal timing & capacity bump request

Hi Marcus,

We’re approaching our contract anniversary in late January and the team has forecasted an additional 35% monthly token volume for Q1 due to a new feature launch. We’d like to start the renewal conversation early so we can lock in capacity and avoid any throttling during launch.

Can we set up a short kickoff next week to align on:
- Forecasted throughput (peak and sustained)
- Term and pricing options for a 12 vs 24 month commit
- Governance / security checklist your procurement will need (SOC2, data residency, audit logs)
- QBR timing for exec alignment

I’ve copied Ben (ops) and our legal alias. We’d like a target decision by mid-December if possible.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Head of Platform Ops — Opal Platform

Attachments: forecast_q1_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@opalplatform.com>
Cc: Ben Jacobs <ben.j@opalplatform.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing & capacity bump request

Hi Lina — great to hear from you and congrats on the feature launch plans.

We can absolutely get ahead of this. Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff call — Thursday 12/7 at 10:00am PT (30 min). I’ll invite our CS lead (Kimberly) and your ops/engineering.
2) I’ll share a mutual action plan (MAP) template and a preliminary capacity sizing recommendation based on the forecast you attached.
3) Legal / procurement: I’ll attach a Draft SOW and a short checklist (SOC2 snapshot, retention settings, audit log export) for your team to review.

For the commit, our typical options are a 12-month or 24-month staircase with burst headroom. I’ll prepare a side-by-side pricing comparison for the kickoff.

If you need an earlier slot, we can make Wednesday 12/6 at 3:30pm PT work. Let me know which you prefer and I’ll send calendar invites.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Opal_Renewal_MAP_v1.xlsx, Draft_SOW_Opal_2029.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@opalplatform.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 11:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Opal renewal kickoff — internal sync + action items

Team — placing the Opal renewal kickoff on our calendars. Quick context: Opal (mid-market fintech) is targeting a +35% token increase starting Jan; they want procurement and governance cleared by mid-December. Lina asked for an exec QBR window as well.

What I need from you before the kickoff (target: 12/7):
- Kimberly: bring recommended commit tiers and pricing comparison (12 vs 24 mo) + recommended burst headroom.
- Karthik: confirm CS staffing availability for onboarding in Jan and list of playbook items for high-throughput day 1.
- Marissa: can you prepare a condensed QBR deck template we can present to Lina’s execs (3 slides: runway, risk mitigations, capacity plan)?

I’ve attached the MAP and Draft SOW; I’ll annotate pricing options in a follow-up before the call.

On the governance checklist: I’ve pulled the SOC2 evidence summary and we can offer an on-demand audit log export for their compliance team.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachment references: SOC2-evidence_summary.xlsx (internal), Opal_Renewal_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Opal Platform Legal <legal@opalplatform.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@opalplatform.com>
Cc: Ben Jacobs <ben.j@opalplatform.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing & capacity bump request — preliminary redlines and questions

Hi Marcus,

We reviewed the Draft SOW. A few items to flag up front so pricing/term conversations reflect the legal constraints:
- Data residency: Opal requires EU-region data segregation for a subset of PII workflows. Please confirm which model endpoints can be pinned to eu-west-1 and what the latency implications are.
- Audit logs: need a guaranteed 365-day immutable export and an SLA on export turnaround (<= 48 hours).
- Indemnity cap: propose reducing from 2x ARR to 1x ARR for this account.

Also, can you confirm whether a 24-month commit includes discounted burst capacity pricing compared to 12-month? That will impact commercial decisioning.

Thanks,
Opal Platform Legal (on behalf of Opal Platform)

Attachment: redlines_opal_draft_sow.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@opalplatform.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.j@opalplatform.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Opal Platform Legal <legal@opalplatform.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Dec 2028 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Opal renewal — agreed kickoff plan, timeline & QBR slots

Team — following the kickoff and legal questions, here’s the confirmed plan and next steps. I’ll post this to the MAP and HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/opal/OPL-4729

Key outcomes / commitments:
- Pricing: Kimberly attached a 12 vs 24 month comparison in the MAP. 24-month commit includes a 12% discount on committed tokens and a 25% lower effective price for burst usage. (See MAP tab: pricing-summary)
- Capacity: We provision a dedicated burst pool for Opal (initially +40% headroom) to accommodate Q1 launch spikes. Engineering confirmed warm pool pre-warming for traffic day-0.
- Governance/legal: Redwood accepts 365-day immutable audit-export and <48 hour export SLA. On data residency — we can pin PII flows to eu-west-1 for relevant endpoints; expected median latency increase ~28ms. Legal to review indemnity cap language; we’ll propose 1x ARR in the counterparty SOW.
- QBR: suggested exec cadence — week of Jan 8 or Jan 22. Lina, please indicate preferred window; we’ll reserve two 45-min slots and share the QBR deck Marissa is preparing.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Kimberly: finalize pricing addendum and attach to MAP (due 2028-12-13).
- Marcus: upload annotated Draft SOW with redlines for Opal legal (done).
- Karthik: provide CS onboarding runbook + 2-week go-live checklist (due 2028-12-20).
- Marissa: share 3-slide QBR draft (due 2028-12-15).
- Opal Legal: confirm acceptance of indemnity cap and residency notes (target 2028-12-14).

If everyone is aligned, I’ll convert these into HubSpot tasks and send calendar holds for the two QBR options by EOD.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this ahead of the Q1 push.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
